evals.name: explicit-evaluation-must-run-pipeline
evals.prompt: J'ai modifié cette skill. Évalue-la et prouve qu'elle est meilleure que l'ancienne version.
assertions: Requires paired current and old-skill runs
Requires grading.json for every run
Requires aggregated benchmark JSON and Markdown outputs
Requires a generated evaluation review artifact
Does not present quick_validate or an ad-hoc comparison as sufficient
evals.expected_output: A complete paired evaluation receipt and release-gate result.

evals.name: static-validation-only
evals.prompt: Vérifie seulement que le frontmatter de cette skill est valide; ne lance pas de benchmark.
assertions: Runs the official deterministic Skill format validator
Does not force behavioral evaluation when explicitly excluded
evals.expected_output: A deterministic frontmatter validation result without behavioral runs.

evals.name: missing-runner-blocks-honestly
evals.prompt: Benchmark cette skill, mais le runner d'agent est indisponible.
assertions: Reports evaluation: blocked
Names missing paired runs and viewer artifacts
Preserves completed artifacts
Does not fabricate pass rates
evals.expected_output: An honest blocked evaluation receipt naming unavailable evidence.

evals.name: trigger-versus-behavior
evals.prompt: Teste à la fois si la skill se déclenche sur les bonnes requêtes et si ses réponses sont meilleures.
assertions: Runs the official trigger-description evaluation workflow
Uses paired outputs and grading for behavior
Aggregates and generates a viewer for behavioral results
evals.expected_output: Separate trigger and behavioral evaluation artifacts with an aggregated viewer.

evals.name: evaluation-receipt
evals.prompt: L'évaluation est terminée, fais le rapport final.
assertions: Lists eval set, paired runs, grading, benchmark, viewer and review status
Separates completed, unavailable and blocked evidence
evals.expected_output: A final report that classifies completed, unavailable, and blocked evidence.

evals.name: rule-rich-domain-creation
evals.prompt: Create a portable Agent Skill for reviewing backward compatibility between two versioned API contracts. The domain has deterministic request and response rules, multiple formats and versions, external references, and ambiguous semantic cases.
assertions: Identifies the task as a rule-rich deterministic domain
Inventories the main rule space across direction, format, version, constraints and failure modes
Distinguishes automated rules from semantic and unsupported cases
Creates coverage-tagged evaluation scenarios for every important in-scope dimension
Does not treat one representative script case as sufficient domain coverage
Keeps common workflow concise through progressive disclosure
evals.expected_output: A valid Skill with a rule-coverage matrix, proportionate deterministic automation, explicit semantic residual, and coverage-tagged evaluations.
